title: rtpa directly protects neurons after intracerebral hemorrhage through pi3k/akt/mtor pathway
core_idea: Investigate the effects and safety of recombinant tissue plasminogen activator (rtPA) on neurons after intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH), and test whether rtPA modulates neuronal apoptosis, autophagy, and ER stress via activation of the PI3K/AKT/MTOR pathway potentially involving the EGF/EGFR axis, using in vivo collagenase-induced ICH and in vitro hemin-induced models plus transcriptome analysis and pharmacologic inhibitors.
tldr: Study aims to assess whether rtPA directly affects neuronal survival mechanisms after ICH by activating PI3K/AKT/MTOR (and the possible role of EGF/EGFR), using animal and cell models with transcriptomics and inhibitor validation.
